newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Senegalese students clash with police.
newsitem.headline: Senegalese students clash with police.

text.p: DAKAR, March 18, Reuter - Students at Senegal's Dakar university ransacked university buildings and clashed with police on Tuesday after they refused to let them hold a meeting on campus, witnesses said.
Police dispersed the students with tear gas and made at least 10 arrests, the witnesses added. Some students hurled stones and ransacked the main administrative building and a restaurant.
"We wanted to hold a meeting and inform our comrades about the outcome of our meeting with the minister of education concerning our living conditions," law student Ousmane Diop told Reuters.
The students have been negotiating over allowances, medical cover and other benefits.
